extra_state_attributes.forecast_description: This sensor shows a forecast all-in electricity tariff price in $/kWh, calculated by combining the calibrated AEMO PD7DAY 7-day pre-dispatch spot price forecast with the applicable network tariff time-of-use component for the AusNet Small Residential Time of Use tariff. The network component ($/kWh) varies by time of day per the tariff period structure above and is sourced from AER-approved distributor pricing. The final price includes a 10% GST component and an additional usage fee (currently 0.0293 $/kWh, configurable via the number entity 'nem_pd7day_vic1_additional_usage_fee') added before GST. IMPORTANT: This is a forecast only and should not be relied upon as an accurate prediction of actual electricity costs. Spot prices are inherently volatile and can differ significantly from forecasts, particularly beyond 24 hours.
